HOW GRANDISON CAN HELP

From a repair to a new room.

Make a useful plumbing repair enquiry

A dripping tap, a toilet problem and a leaking waste connection need different information. Say where the problem is, when it happens and whether it is constant. Send a close-up of the affected fitting and a wider view showing the available access.

  • Plumbing repairs & installations →
  • Describe your plumbing job →

Choose replacement fittings with the pipework in mind

For bathroom installation or a kitchen fitting change, check dimensions and connections before purchasing. A new basin, toilet or shower may need more than a simple swap. If you want to move fittings, share the proposed layout so the supply and waste routes can be discussed.

  • Bathroom renovation planning →
  • Shower room installations →

Include heating in your renovation brief

Mention radiator installation or a heated towel rail when planning the room. For boiler servicing, boiler repairs or replacement, give the appliance details separately so the enquiry can be assessed properly. Confirm the scope of each job rather than assuming it is included in a bathroom quote.

  • Boiler servicing →

BEFORE YOU ENQUIRE

Replacement fittings: check before you buy

A new sink, tap or toilet is not always a direct swap. Dimensions, fixing positions, connections and waste routes can differ. A photo of the current fitting and a link to the replacement can make the initial discussion more useful and help avoid ordering something unsuitable.

  • Measure the available space.
  • Share the model or product link if you have chosen a fitting.
  • Mention restricted access to connections.

Include your postcode and preferred timing. Confirm the agreed work, who supplies the fittings and any preparation or finishing tasks before booking.

GOOD TO KNOW

Your questions,
answered.

Can you fit a tap or basin I have already chosen?

Share the product link or model and photographs of the existing installation. Suitability, connections and the work involved need to be checked before fitting is agreed.

Can I enquire from Kelty or Crossgates?

Yes. These enquiries are welcome within the wider Fife service area. Include your postcode and the job details to confirm availability.

Can several small jobs be discussed together?

Yes. List each fitting or room that needs attention, with photographs where helpful, so the scope can be discussed together.
